context.benefitFormula: sum(E[t] * 0.08 * (0.20 + 0.20) / (1 + realDiscountRate)^t), t=14..61; E includes scenario wage growth

caveats: Scenarios share one model and experiment; they are not independent studies or confidence bounds.
Earnings conversion is observational; omitted variables and scaling may change returns.
Benefits omit fringe compensation and non-earnings effects; universal paid employment can overstate benefits.
National all-grade spending approximates early-grade costs; teacher supply and STAR sample composition limit extrapolation.
The 0.20 SD values are model inputs, not newly extracted trial estimates with known standard errors.

Recomputing discounted costs from the printed annual schedule reproduces four rows after rounding; the 6% row rounds to 7301 rather than the reported 7300. This dataset retains the published value of 7300.
